Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice sender and VAT evidence — next steps

Hi Camila,

Quick question as we get set up on your side: who will be the invoice originator for Acme Health — will Redwood create and send monthly invoices on your letterhead, or do you expect us to self-bill and pull invoices from the portal?

For our AP control, we need to know:
- The invoice sender (Redwood or Acme)
- Preferred delivery channel (SFTP/API to our ERP, portal push with downloads, or email PDF copies)
- Where we should expect the VAT registration number to appear on the invoice (line item vs header)
- Any required evidence for VAT exemption (we can attach a VAT certificate)

If Redwood will originate, please let us know the contact and remit instructions you will print on invoices, and the fields you will use for PO numbers and remit-to references so we can map it in our ERP.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if it helps.

Sarah Lim
AP Manager, Acme Health
finance@acme-health.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice sender and VAT evidence — next steps

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front and then details below:

1) We can originate invoices on behalf of customers (Redwood-originated) or allow self-billing (you download from the portal).
2) Recommended flow for most enterprise customers: Redwood originates invoices and pushes to the portal, with automated email copies to your AP inbox. That gives you both machine-readable delivery and the human-readable PDF in the AP queue.

If you want Redwood to originate invoices, we'll need:
- Billing contact and remit-to (name, address, tax IDs) to print on the invoice header.
- Confirm where you want the PO number: we typically put PO in the invoice "Reference" field and as a top-line custom field for XML.
- VAT evidence: a scanned VAT certificate (or W-8/W-9 for US entities) and the VAT registration number string.
- Preferred invoice formats: we can deliver PDF + optional XML (Ubl/Peppol-style) or a webhook with JSON payload.

I attached a small sample XML file with the fields our billing system sends (sample-xml-invoice.xml). If your ERP needs a different tag for PO or vendor number, let us know and Marissa (cc'd) will route a mapping request to our billing team.

If you prefer self-billing via portal only, we'll provide a vendor onboarding link and you can opt out of email copies. Note: self-billing can delay remittance mapping if your AP team requires a specific reference field.

Would you like us to originate and send a test April invoice (PDF + XML) to your AP inbox so you can validate PO mapping?

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: sample-xml-invoice.xml (attachment stub)

Thanks Camila / Sarah — quick operations note from Billing Ops:

We can originate monthly invoices for Acme Health and will enable portal delivery plus automated monthly PDF email copies to finance@acme-health.com. Please confirm the following so we can finalize the vendor record:
- Remit-to name and address exactly as you want it printed (line 1, line 2, city, country).
- AP contact for invoice questions (name + email + phone).
- Default currency for invoicing (USD) and whether you require EU VAT separately broken out or embedded in line items.
- PO placement: confirm you want the PO to appear in the invoice Reference field and the XML <OrderReference> tag.

We received a scanned VAT certificate in a follow-up email earlier today (please re-send if we're missing it). We'll attach it to the vendor file and include the VAT registration number on the invoice header as requested.

I will run a test invoice for April 1 (pro forma) and send to your inbox. If that looks good we will turn on recurring generation and portal push for the next run.

Attachments on our side: billing system will include the PDF and an optional XML attachment (sample-xml-invoice.xml).

Best,
